summary: 一种强效、长效的迷幻兴奋剂。历史上很少被刻意使用，但偶尔被当作 LSD 出售。然而近年来在研究化学品社区中找到了自己的位置。
effectsSummary: DOI is a potent psychedelic with effects similar to DOB but slightly shorter duration. Visual hallucinations, altered perception, ego dissolution.
generalRisks: Dangerous increase in blood pressure. Risk of panic attacks and psychological distress. Overheating risk.
longtermRisks: No research results on long-term risks. HPPD possible.
saferUse: 只使用毫克秤精确测量剂量。
[TBT] Mixed use of these potent substances should be avoided at all costs.

[TBT] As amphetamine derivatives, DOI can be particularly draining because of their long duration of action. Light vitamin-rich food, fruits, vegetable juices, vitamins and minerals promote a soft landing after the trip has subsided and can weaken a hangover.
[TBT] Plan enough time for recovery after the trip (at least 1 day)!
[TBT] A trip with DOI should remain an exceptional experience. Make sure to take long breaks from consumption so that the experience can be processed.
